name_reason: Conforms to convention: data_fd2_<domain=chapter>_<descriptor=post_action_handler_table>. The descriptor reflects both role (per-chapter post-action dispatch) and data type (table/array of function pointers). Not a battle-core table (it is chapter dispatch), so data_fd2_chapter_* is correct rather than data_fd2_battle_*. No Ghidra address residue: the suffix carries no hex equal to its own or another address; '_table' is a type descriptor, not an address. No domain ID to preserve (the chapter id is the runtime index, not part of the symbol name).
purpose: Per-chapter 'post-action' handler jump table: the handler invoked once after each acting unit (player/NPC) finishes its action, used as a per-chapter scripted-event probe (e.g. check-battle-end / story triggers).
logic_summary: 30-entry const array of function pointers in .object2, indexed by current_chapter_id (DAT_00053C03; index 0 = chapter 1 .. index 29 = chapter 30). Every reader uses the same pattern: MOV EAX,[0x53C03]; PUSH <active char index>; CALL dword ptr [EAX*0x4 + 0x51B19]; ADD ESP,0x4 -> cdecl, single uint32 argument (active char index / event_arg), void return, stride 4. Chapters lacking a special post-action point at the shared default fd2_check_battle_end_default_handler (0x205B4); chapters 22/27/28 share fd2_chapter_22_27_28_post_action_shared (0x20A87). Verified table bytes [0..29] decode exactly to the handler addresses listed in the chtab.c initializer (default at indices 0,2-8,10,13,23; ch23 distinct at index 22 = 0x20AAF; shared at indices 21,26,27).
datatype: void (*const [30])(uint32)  -- const array of 30 cdecl function pointers; Ghidra shows pointer[30] in .object2
element_semantics: Each element is a void(*)(uint32) cdecl handler for one chapter (element i => chapter i+1). The uint32 argument is the active character index (event_arg) pushed by the caller. Distinct per-chapter handlers, with a shared default (fd2_check_battle_end_default_handler) for chapters with no special post-action and one handler shared by chapters 22/27/28.
notes: Existing chtab.c comment block (lines 13-29) is already precise, accurate, and ASCII; verified against Ghidra evidence (xrefs: 5 read sites across 4 functions fd2_game_main_loop / fd2_tick_status_effects_and_show_messages / fd2_npc_turn_phase_team1 / fd2_enemy_turn_phase_team0 x2; no writers => const confirmed). Decompile of fd2_npc_turn_phase_team1 and disassembly of fd2_enemy_turn_phase_team0 both confirm cdecl single-uint32-arg stride-4 chapter-1-indexed access. No Edit to chtab.c (comment kept).
